paragraphs: Heathrow’s ambition to refine airport operations through data science mirrors my recent work building end‑to‑end pipelines that turn raw data into actionable insights. I crafted scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to enable real‑time decision support.

I also designed a Python‑based MCP agentic tool for a Madrid‑based start‑up, integrating FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI. The prototype was showcased in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating rapid prototyping and stakeholder engagement.
